Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.sec1Desc: Cookies are small text files placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit our platform. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to site owners. Cookies cannot run programs or deliver viruses to your computer; they are uniquely assigned to your browser and can only be read by a web server in the domain that issued them to you.
Cookies.sec2Desc: EGFootball5 uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform. We use cookies to: (a) keep you logged into your account securely between sessions; (b) remember your language and locale preferences (Arabic/English, RTL/LTR); (c) maintain your booking cart or pending reservation state during the checkout process; (d) analyze aggregate platform usage through anonymized analytics to improve our service; and (e) deliver relevant features such as saved favourite pitches and match history.
Cookies.sec3Desc: We use the following categories of cookies: (a) Strictly Necessary Cookies — required for the platform to function and cannot be switched off. These include session authentication tokens via Firebase Authentication; (b) Functional Cookies — enable enhanced functionality such as remembering your preferred language and locale setting across sessions; (c) Analytics Cookies — we use anonymized, aggregated analytics to understand how users interact with the platform, including which pitches are most viewed and booking funnel performance. No personally identifiable information is collected through analytics cookies; (d) Third-Party Cookies — certain features (e.g., embedded map providers) may set their own cookies subject to their own privacy policies.
Cookies.sec4Desc: Authentication session cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with secure access to your account. These cookies are set by Firebase Authentication (a Google service) and expire when you log out or after an extended period of inactivity. Without these cookies, the platform cannot verify your identity or maintain your booking sessions, and core features such as pitch reservations and payment flows will not function.
Cookies.sec5Desc: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most modern browsers allow you to: (a) view cookies currently stored on your device; (b) allow, block, or delete specific cookies; (c) set preferences for future cookie handling. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies will prevent you from logging into the platform and completing bookings. Disabling functional cookies may cause certain preferences (such as your language selection) to reset on each visit. Instructions for managing cookies vary by browser — please consult the help documentation for your specific browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) for detailed guidance.
Cookies.sec6Desc: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, regulation, or our business practices. Any significant changes will be communicated to registered users via email or in-app notification. Continued use of the platform after any update constitutes your acceptance of the revised Cookie Policy. The date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised. If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us at support@egfootball5.com.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.sec1Desc: EGFootball5 collects the following categories of personal information: (a) Account Information — your full name, mobile phone number, and optionally your profile photo when you register an account; (b) Booking Information — pitch selection, date and time slot, number of players, booking type (public/private), and payment deposit records; (c) Usage Data — pages visited, features used, and session duration collected in anonymized form for platform improvement; (d) Device and Technical Data — IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers collected automatically when you access the platform; (e) Communications — any messages you send to support or pitch managers through the platform. We do not collect or store payment card numbers; all financial transactions are processed by certified third-party payment providers.
Privacy.sec2Desc: We use the information we collect for the following purposes: (a) to create and manage your account and authenticate your identity securely; (b) to process, confirm, and manage pitch bookings and communicate booking status updates; (c) to send booking confirmations, deposit reminders, and platform notifications via in-app alerts or SMS; (d) to enable pitch owners and venue managers to verify your identity for the purpose of facilitating your reserved slot; (e) to improve and personalize the platform experience, including recommending relevant pitches based on your history; (f) to detect, investigate, and prevent fraudulent bookings, abuse of the platform, or violations of our Terms of Service; (g) to comply with applicable legal obligations in the Arab Republic of Egypt and other applicable jurisdictions.
Privacy.sec3Desc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. We share your information only in the following limited circumstances: (a) with pitch owners and venue managers — we share your name, phone number, and booking details with the specific pitch owner whose facility you have booked, solely to facilitate your reservation; (b) with service providers — we engage trusted third-party service providers (including Firebase/Google for infrastructure, and licensed payment processors) who access your data only to perform services on our behalf and are bound by confidentiality obligations; (c) for legal compliance — we may disclose your information when required by applicable law, court order, or governmental authority; (d) in a business transfer — in the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or part of our business assets, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to equivalent privacy protections.
Privacy.sec4Desc: We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active or as necessary to provide you with our services. Booking records are retained for a minimum of three (3) years following the booking date for legal and tax compliance purposes. If you delete your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law. Anonymized and aggregated data (from which you cannot be individually identified) may be retained indefinitely for analytical purposes.
Privacy.sec5Desc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including: (a) TLS/HTTPS encryption for all data transmitted between your device and our servers; (b) Firebase Security Rules governing database read/write access so that users can only access their own data; (c) role-based access controls ensuring that pitch owners can only view data related to their own bookings; (d) regular security reviews of our platform infrastructure. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
Privacy.sec6Desc: Subject to applicable law, you have the following rights regarding your personal information: (a) Right of Access — you may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you; (b) Right to Rectification — you may correct inaccurate or incomplete data through your profile settings at any time; (c) Right to Erasure — you may request deletion of your account and associated personal data, subject to our legal retention obligations; (d) Right to Data Portability — you may request an export of your booking history and profile data in a structured format; (e) Right to Object — you may object to certain types of data processing, including profiling. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@egfootball5.com.
Privacy.sec7Desc: The EGFootball5 platform is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and become aware that your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately at support@egfootball5.com and we will take prompt steps to delete such information from our records.
Privacy.sec8Desc: If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding this Privacy Policy or the way we handle your personal data, please contact us at: EGFootball5 Support Team, Email: support@egfootball5.com. We aim to respond to all privacy inquiries within 5 business days. This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.sec1Desc: By accessing or using EGFootball5 (the "Platform"), you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms") and our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated herein by reference. If you do not agree to these Terms in their entirety, you must immediately discontinue use of the Platform. We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time; continued use of the Platform following any modification constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms. These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and EGFootball5.
Terms.sec2Desc: You must be at least 16 years of age to use the Platform. By creating an account, you represent that all information you provide is accurate and complete. You are solely responsible for: (a) maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials; (b) all activities that occur under your account; (c) notifying us immediately at support@egfootball5.com if you suspect unauthorized access to your account. EGFootball5 reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that are found to contain false information, are used fraudulently, or otherwise violate these Terms.
Terms.sec3Desc: All bookings made through EGFootball5 are subject to slot availability and final confirmation by the pitch owner or venue manager. When you select a time slot, it is temporarily locked for a period of 15 minutes to allow you to complete payment of the required deposit. If the deposit is not received within this window, the lock is automatically released and the slot becomes available to other users. A confirmed booking is only established upon receipt of the deposit and issuance of a booking confirmation to your registered phone number. EGFootball5 acts as an intermediary platform and is not a party to the agreement between you and the pitch owner.
Terms.sec4Desc: Deposit amounts are set by individual pitch owners and displayed on each pitch listing. Deposits are non-refundable except in cases where the pitch owner cancels the booking or the pitch is unavailable through no fault of the user. The remaining balance, if any, is payable directly to the pitch owner or venue at the time of play according to the terms established by that venue. EGFootball5 does not process or retain payment card details; all payment transactions are handled by certified, PCI-compliant third-party payment processors. In the event of a payment dispute, users should first attempt to resolve the matter directly with the pitch owner, and may escalate to EGFootball5 support if resolution cannot be reached.
Terms.sec5Desc: Cancellation policies are set by individual pitch owners and are displayed on each pitch listing prior to booking. Users may cancel a confirmed booking through their profile page. The refund of any deposit is subject to the cancellation policy of the specific pitch owner and the timing of the cancellation relative to the scheduled slot. EGFootball5 is not liable for any refunds owed by pitch owners to users. Where a pitch owner fails to honor a confirmed booking, EGFootball5 will make reasonable efforts to assist users in obtaining a refund or alternative booking, but does not guarantee such outcomes.
Terms.sec6Desc: You agree not to engage in any of the following prohibited activities: (a) creating fake, fraudulent, or duplicate bookings intended to block time slots without genuine intent to play; (b) providing false identity information when registering or making a booking; (c) harassing, threatening, or abusing other users, pitch owners, or platform staff; (d) attempting to circumvent any security measure, authentication system, or access control of the Platform; (e) scraping, crawling, or otherwise extracting data from the Platform without prior written consent; (f) listing, selling, or transferring your booking to a third party for commercial gain; (g) using the Platform for any unlawful purpose under Egyptian law or the laws of any applicable jurisdiction. Violation of these prohibitions may result in immediate account suspension, permanent ban, and referral to relevant legal authorities.
Terms.sec7Desc: EGFootball5 provides the Platform on an "as is" and "as available" basis. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, EGFootball5 and its officers, directors, employees, and agents shall not be liable for: (a) any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of or inability to use the Platform; (b) any physical injury, accident, or property damage occurring at a pitch venue booked through the Platform; (c) the conduct, actions, or omissions of pitch owners or venue managers; (d) any loss arising from unauthorized access to your account due to your failure to safeguard your credentials. Our total aggregate liability for any claim arising under these Terms shall not exceed the deposit amount paid by you for the specific booking giving rise to the claim.
Terms.sec8Desc: All content on the EGFootball5 Platform, including but not limited to text, graphics, logos, icons, images, and software, is the property of EGFootball5 or its licensors and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use the Platform for personal, non-commercial purposes. If a dispute cannot be resolved through negotiation within 30 days, it shall be referred to the competent courts of Cairo, Egypt, whose jurisdiction both parties hereby irrevocably accept.
